   d=private/secret_name

 boot=(stage/'bootstrap.php').read_text()

 boot=boot.replace("__DIR__ . '/../data/knowledge.json'","__DIR__ . '/data/knowledge.json'")
 (stage/'bootstrap.php').write_text(boot)

 (stage/'demo_config.php').write_text(demo)
 live=(stage/'live_session.php').read_text()

 if verify.returncode!=0 or b'invalid_mission' not in verify.stdout.encode():
